summary.value: Provides the file view command for previewing workspace-relative files with path validation, size-bounded reading, binary detection, and dual CLI/web output handling. Web presentation is delegated to renderers, which constructs code-view stylesheet and WebNodeRoot displays for highlighting, copying, and inline-editing with breadcrumb and timeline integration.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Leaf command implementation under the plugins/file/commands 20-command aggregation, dispatched via the file plugin's centralized adapter.ts/handleFile routing. Holds the read-only preview role within the filesystem-ops family (complementing create/edit/delete/rename/tree/search and distinct from git/bottomup/transfer families), isolating safe reads from mutations. Owns validation and bounded-read execution in handler.ts while delegating web code-view, highlighting, copy, inline-edit, breadcrumb and timeline presentation to its renderers child, following the shared validate-containment → execute → CLI/web-adapt lifecycle.

files.adapter.ts: Adapter seam between the centralized file dispatcher and this command's handler/renderers. Resolves workspace root and parses path/previousDir/line/lineScrollToken before calling handleViewCommand, then branches to CLI text or WebNodeRoot rendering via renderers - the dual CLI/web adaptation pattern shared across file/git commands.
files.definition.ts: Declarative registration contract that exposes view in the 20-command surface aggregated by plugins/file/commands. Defines required workspace-relative path with optional previousDir and line for history/line-highlighting, consumed by init.ts plugin registration and help aggregation.
files.handler.ts: Core execution logic called by the adapter, encapsulating workspace containment guards (escape/not-found/directory), null-byte binary detection and 256KB truncation into a structured FileViewResult. Provides the safe, side-effect-free read counterpart to mutating file commands, leaving CLI/web presentation to adapter/renderers.
